dedupe_keys.name: data for divergent humidity driven growth in urban air conditioning energy demand under climate change

description: Xinchang Li and collaborators publish daily global urban climate and air-conditioning demand projections generated with an updated Community Earth System Model under SSP3-7.0. The June 2026 release provides NetCDF variables for urban temperature, relative humidity, total and sensible cooling-demand flux, and surface pressure, together with grid area and urban fraction. Files cover 2015–2024 and 2090–2099 on a 0.9375-by-1.25-degree grid; continuous intervening years are not listed despite the README’s broader period summary. Downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. These simulations can inform climate-sensitive electricity-demand and cooling-capacity scenarios. Only urban grid cells contain values, and energy totals require the supplied area information. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. One scenario and coarse urban representation limit uncertainty assessment and local transfer. The metadata and README were read; numerical results were not downloaded or validated.
